subject: Procura renewal: marketplace billing transition & co-sell commitment
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mike Larson <mike.larson@procura.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:02:15 -0800
Subject: Procura renewal: marketplace billing transition & co-sell commitment

Hi Mike —

Thanks again for taking the call today. As discussed, Procura's upcoming annual renewal (PRC-2045) is a good candidate to convert from direct invoicing to Azure Marketplace billing with a co-sell commitment. The goals we agreed on: preserve your discounting, keep a clean invoice flow for your procurement team, and enable co-sell incentives on our side.

Next steps I proposed on the call:
- I’ll share a short SOW that maps existing SKUs to Marketplace SKUs for your finance team.
- Your procurement team confirms acceptance of monthly marketplace invoicing and Seller-of-Record (Microsoft) terms.
- We prepare a 1-page amendment and a DocuSign for signature to lock the switch effective 1/1/2028.

Attached: Redwood_Procura_Marketplace_Migration_SOW_v1.pdf (draft mapping & timeline).

Can you confirm who on your side needs to be on the DocuSign (procurement + finance)? If you want, we can do a short sync with your procurement and our billing specialist this week.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Procura_Marketplace_Migration_SOW_v1.pdf (45 KB)]

From: Mike Larson <mike.larson@procura.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@procura.io>, Procura Finance <procura-finance@procura.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 11:14:48 -0800
Subject: Re: Procura renewal: marketplace billing transition & co-sell commitment

Irene —

Appreciate the summary and the SOW. Quick clarifying questions from procurement/finance after a quick review:
1) Will the marketplace conversion change our committed spend or just the invoicing path?
2) Who will be Seller of Record (we assume Microsoft) and do we need any additional reseller paperwork?
3) We have a negotiated seat-based discount in our current contract. Can that discount be preserved in the marketplace SKU mapping?

Attached is the SKU list our billing team pulled — we’d like you to confirm the mapping and any delta in unit price. Also please share a sample amendment we can circulate internally.

Best,
Mike
Mike Larson
Head of Procurement, Procura
[Attachment: Procura_SKU_Mapping_Costs.xlsx (12 KB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 08:17:02 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Procura renewal: marketplace billing transition & co-sell commitment

Laura / Ben —

Looping you in to handle pricing confirmation and the amendment language. Key asks from Procura: preserve their negotiated discount, confirm Seller-of-Record = Microsoft, and ensure monthly invoicing cadence aligns with their SAP integration.

Items for our side:
- Ben: confirm if the Marketplace SKU we propose matches existing unit economics or whether we need a transitional price adder.
- Laura: draft a one-page amendment that states the conversion date, Seller-of-Record, and any needed indemnities for procurement. Keep it simple.

I’ve attached Mike’s SKU export. I’ll aim to provide a mapped SKU + recommended price change by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — I’ll be on the sync with procurement after you’ve prepared the draft.

— Irene

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 11:45:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procura renewal: marketplace billing transition & co-sell commitment

I looked at Procura's SKU export and the draft mapping. Quick take:
- We can preserve list-equivalent economics for 3 of the 4 major SKUs by mapping them to Azure-metered equivalents plus a marketplace support SKU to capture some admin overhead. That keeps their effective per-seat cost the same to within ~2%.
- The smaller analytics SKU is currently custom-priced; recommend a transitional fixed price for Q1 2028 and revisit at the next renewal.
- Co-sell credit: if Procura signs the amendment with a minimum co-sell commit (>$250k ACV through marketplace), we can offer a 5% co-sell rebate applied as monthly bill credits. That helps maintain their discount.

I’m attaching a short summary table (pasted below) and will update the SOW with the mapping.

Summary (high level):
- SKU-A -> AZ-M1 (no price change)
- SKU-B -> AZ-M2 (+1.8% list)
- SKU-C -> AZ-ANALYTICS (fixed Q1 price)
- Support SKU -> MARKETPLACE-SUPPORT (new mapping)

Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mike Larson <mike.larson@procura.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 09:05:07 -0800
Subject: Procura amendment v0.1 and next steps

Hi Mike —

Thanks for the details. Attached is a one-page amendment (amendment_v0.1) that:
- confirms Seller-of-Record = Microsoft for marketplace invoices,
- transitions invoicing to monthly marketplace invoices effective 2028-01-01,
- includes a clause preserving existing negotiated discount via a co-sell rebate (5% monthly credit if commit threshold met),
- lists the mapped SKUs (Ben’s mapping) as an appendix.

What we need from you to finalize:
1) Procurement approval on Seller-of-Record and monthly cadence.
2) Finance confirmation that the 5% rebate as a credit is acceptable to Procura accounting.
3) Names and emails for the signers so we can send DocuSign.

If we get internal approvals by Friday, we can send DocuSign early next week for signature and hit the 1/1/2028 target.

Laura Bennett
Contracts & Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Procura_Marketplace_Migration_SOW_v1.pdf (updated), Amendment_v0.1.pdf (8 KB)]

From: Procura Finance <procura-finance@procura.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Mike Larson <mike.larson@procura.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procura amendment v0.1 and next steps

Laura, Irene —

Procura Finance reviewed the amendment and the proposed credit structure. We confirm finance is comfortable receiving the 5% co-sell rebate as a monthly credit applied to the Marketplace invoice (please include an itemized line on the invoice). We also confirm Seller-of-Record = Microsoft is acceptable.

Signers:
- Jill Park, VP Finance <jill.park@procura.io>
- Mike Larson, Head of Procurement <mike.larson@procura.io>

Please send the DocuSign to the two signers above and carbon copy procura-finance. We aim to have the signed amendment back by 2027-11-30.

Thanks,
Procura Finance
[No attachments]
